children: The European Commission approved RASONQUE (daraxonrasib) for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy. The authorization covers EU member states and Iceland, Norway and Liechtenstein; access timing varies by country.
EC approved RASONQUE for previously treated metastatic PDAC
EU marketing authorization expands the drug's approved market; national pricing and reimbursement processes still affect patient access.
Phase 3 trial met all primary and key secondary endpoints
The reported trial outcome supported approval in both the RAS G12 mutant and overall intent-to-treat populations.
EU authorization excludes the UK and Switzerland
Separate regulatory processes are required in those markets, limiting the scope of this authorization.

This is a commercial-stage oncology company's regulatory milestone, following positive Phase 3 results and prior U.S. FDA approval noted in the release. Further country-level pricing, health-technology assessment and reimbursement decisions will determine the timing of European patient access.
from Revolution Medicines, Inc. distributed by GlobeNewswire.

Revolution Medicines is working to enable patient access in European Union, with timing dependent on country-specific pricing and reimbursement processes

title: Revolution Medicines (RVMD) Wins EU Approval for RASONQUE in Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer
